resources.string: Tap Paste and Vazie VPN will read what is on your clipboard. It reads it here, on your device, and it goes nowhere else. A subscription link is the one exception: it is opened, to download its list.

Anyone who receives this link can use the server exactly as you do. Send it only to yourself or to somebody you would hand your password to.
Put your %1$s link or a subscription link in the field, or tap the button beside it to take it from the clipboard.
An example of a configuration link
Not sure what you have? Paste it anyway — if Vazie VPN doesn\'t recognise it, it will say so and won\'t try to guess.
A subscription link works too: Vazie VPN opens it once to download its list of configurations. The request goes to that link\'s server and nowhere else.
For now Vazie VPN reads only %1$s, as one link or as a subscription. More formats are coming soon.
